notes.title: ACHIEVEMENTS!
notes.content:
[h1]ACHIEVEMENTS HAVE BEEN ADDED TO THE GAME! [/h1]
The game will feature a total of 30 achievements.  
You can earn them through game progress or specific choices.  
The thirtieth and final achievement can only be unlocked by collecting all the previous ones! But will you be up to the challenge? The answer is not far away now!
